content: They use word injection (WI) alignment on PPMI vectors with CD. This approach avoids the complex alignment procedure for embeddings and is applicable to embeddings and count-based methods. They compare two implementations of word injection BIBREF23, BIBREF0 as these showed different results on different data sets.
